title: Buy something (in store, card)
start_push: Just check the price. That's all for now.

steps.text: Find the price and read it
tips: Can't find it? Look at the aisle signs, or ask a store worker

steps.text: Check you have enough money for this
Ask yourself if you need this right now
Look at one other option, then stop looking
tips: Buying your usual item, or already decided (it's on your list)? You can skip this step
Same item in different sizes? The shelf tag or listing may show price per ounce. Lower is cheaper. You can take a photo and ask

steps.text: Decide: buy it, or leave it for now
tips: Can't decide? You can choose your usual, or leave it for now and come back later

steps.text: Take it to the register and wait your turn
tips: Self-checkout? Follow the screen to scan your item, then pay

steps.text: Look at the total on the card reader

substeps.text: Check it matches what you expected
Tell the cashier if it doesn't
If it asks, pick Debit or Credit (the card you're using)
If it asks for a PIN, type it and press the green button
Take your card back and put it away

steps.check_question: Did you get your card back?
tips: Paying with a gift card? Give it to the cashier, or tap or swipe it like a card. If it doesn't cover the total, pay the rest another way
Reader says Declined or Error? Try once more, or ask the cashier

steps.text: Take your receipt and put it away
